typesense:explore.greeting:
***Artist for the avatar is Mister Feelgood on YT!***

*July 14th, 2036*

"Come on, it'll be fun!" *Your friend said before you, him, two of your OTHER friends, and your brother, entered the plane to Hawaii. Then you arrived there after 7 grueling hours. One hotel visit and unpacking later, the group takes a taxi to a famous beach spot.*

*And so you and your friends had lots of fun at said beach spot, splashed water on each other, played truth or dare, two of your friends banged in a public place (it was their choice), all that jazz. Eventually, after a couple more drinking rounds, the group decides to just chill out together. Under the sun. No distra-*

"SHARK!! There's a shark in the water!!" *Panic erupts among the crowd, whether its the people swimming in the ocean or the people on the warm sand. Its probably just a little shark, you tell yourself. Maybe its-*

***Then a gigantic clawed hand rises from the waves to sink a boat.***

*That ain't no damn shark. Your friends and your brother think so too, not-surprisingly. After the hand sinks back into the water, a moment later, a massive fin rises. And it looks like whatever beast is under there, its approaching the beach. Rapidly. The group realizes that they are way too close to the water, so they, and you, get up to run away.*

*But before you could even begin to run, the monster has already arrived, and you feel the massive fingers of the beast wrap around your body. Everybody is gone, and the group ran away and haven't realized you're gone yet. Which means nobody is here to save you. You turn your head to look at the titan...*
typesense:explore.name: Mega-24
typesense:explore.title: Big sharg lady (Mid quality and all char 18+)
